test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 02 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The current population of a town is 12,800. It increases by 25% and 35% in two successive years but decreases by 5% in the third year. What is the population of the town at the end of the third year?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net multiplying factor = 1.25 × 1.35 × 0.95

Population = 12800 × (5/4) × (27/20) × (19/20)

Population = 8 × 5 × 27 × 19 = 40 × 513 = 20520

**∴ The correct answer is 20,520.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Current population = 12,800. **Increase** in 1st year = 25%, 2ⁿd year = 35%. **Decrease** in 3rd year = 5%.

**Formula:** Final Population = P × (1 + R₁/100) × (1 + R₂/100) × (1 − R₃/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87d25c891ef50e89b7ff4c3e71f007dc9a5b74ec0be5f95291823e09daf64169.png] 

⇒ Population after 1st year = 12800 × (125/100) = 12800 × 1.25 = 16000

⇒ Population after 2ⁿd year = 16000 × (135/100) = 16000 × 1.35 = 21600

⇒ Population after 3rd year = 21600 × (95/100) = 21600 × 0.95

⇒ Final Population = 216 × 95 = 20520

**∴ The correct answer is 20,520.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Percentage Change

When a value changes by x% and then y% successively, the net change is given by [x + y + (xy/100)]%.

Fractional Equivalent

Using fractions simplifies calculations: 25% = 1/4 (increase → 5/4), 5% = 1/20 (decrease → 19/20).

Population Growth Formula

It is similar to compound interest: A = P(1 ± r/100)ⁿ, where ± depends on increase or decrease.</p
